entries.title: Pareto 26.10 Preview
entries.summary: Unbiased's newer composite model joins the catalog: 1,048,576-token context, text and image input, tool calling, and a 131,072-token maximum output at $0.80 / $3.20 per million input / output tokens. BYOK-only via OpenRouter.

entries.title: Fledge Alpha
entries.summary: Fledge Alpha joins the catalog as a free stealth preview: a 1,048,576-token context window, text and image input, tool calling, and reasoning effort on low / high / max — $0 / $0 through OpenCode Zen.

entries.title: PPLX Decider v1 (27B)
entries.summary: Perplexity's multimodal decision model joins the Decisions family: send state — text or images — and typed questions, get back a probability distribution over a fixed set of answers, not generated chat text.

entries.title: Strands Decider 2B
entries.summary: Strands Labs' open-weight decision model joins the Decisions family: run `strands-decider serve` on your own hardware and route POST /api/v1/decisions to it through AnyRouter BYOK.

entries.title: EuroLLM 9B IT disabled
entries.summary: Cloudflare has not published per-token pricing for this hosted SKU, so it cannot be billed accurately. It is listed for reference and will return once a published rate is available.
